senses.gloss: f. (קָצַב) decision, definition, limit, definite scope.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 52a:7">Gitt. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>דבר שיש לו ק׳</he> a thing (religious duty) for which there is a definite time and limit v. <cite ref="S01783"><he>קָצַב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 6:5">Pes. VI, 5</cite> <he>אם אמרת … שיש להן ק׳ וכ׳</he> you cannot draw an analogy between congregational offerings (on the Sabbath), which are definite, and the Passover sacrifice, which is indefinite; Y. ib. 33ᵃ. Ib. 33ᶜ bot. [read:] <he>מאי אית לך דבר שאין לו ק׳</he> what do you mean by saying, a thing which is undefined? <he>שלא נתנה התורה ק׳ וכ׳</he> the Law does not define how many Passover sacrifices supersede the Sabbath each year (whereas the number of the daily sacrifices is definite). Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ top <he>כנותן קי׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00252"><he>מִדָּה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:20">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00479"><he>מוֹכֵס</he></cite> h.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:5">B. Mets. IX, 5</cite> <he>מה ק׳</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>) <cite ref="K01151"><he>כרי</he></cite> what standard is ‘a pile of grain’? i.e. this cannot be made a standard alike for large and small fields.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:3:2">Y. Shek. II, 46ᵈ</cite> top <he>שקִצְבָתָן מן התורה</he> (ed. Krot. <he>שקִצְוָו׳</he>) which are defined in the Biblical law (as to numbers and times); a. fr.
